backup.guideStep1: Connect an Externe drive via USB (Nont the Clé de secours).
backup.guideStep2: Under “Target drive”, pick the Externe disk — Nont /dev/sda (stick).
backup.guideStep3: Click “Mount ext4 …” if the Retourup Partition is Nont mounted yet.
backup.guideStep4: Pick a source: for tests use a small USB NTFS disk or NTFS Partition.
backup.guideStep5: Click “Create Retourup plan” — then “Start Retourup” when the plan is ready.
